title: Light box design transfer
subtitle: Tracing a design through fabric using a backlit surface.
excerpt: A light box illuminates the design from beneath so it shows through the fabric above it. You trace the lines directly onto the cloth with a water-soluble pen. The fastest transfer method for any fabric fine enough to see through.
sourceNotes: Technique using contemporary equipment (LED light pads). Design transfer principles consistent with Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopaedia of Needlework (1886), Project Gutenberg #20776, which describes window-light tracing.

glossaryTerms.definition: A flat LED panel that illuminates from beneath, making designs visible through fabric or paper placed on top. Used for tracing and design transfer.

content.text: is the fastest transfer method for thin fabrics. Place the design on the lit surface, lay the fabric over it, and trace the design lines with a water-soluble pen. The backlight makes the design visible through the cloth even if the design would normally be too faint to see.

items.name: Design printed or drawn on paper

content.text: How to use a light box for transfer
Switch on the light box and dim the room lighting if possible.
Place the printed design on the light box surface, right side up.
Lay the fabric over the design and tape both in position so neither can move.
Trace the design lines onto the fabric with the water-soluble pen. Use a light touch.
Remove the fabric from the light box, mount in a hoop, and stitch.

On a bright day, tape the design to a clean window, lay the fabric over it, and trace. This is the original light-box method and works for thin fabrics and simple designs. Keep the room dim behind you to increase the contrast.

items.symptom: The design is not visible through the fabric
items.cause: The fabric is too thick or opaque for light-box tracing.
items.fix: Use carbon paper or prick-and-pounce for heavier fabrics. Light box transfer works only for thin fabric, roughly light to medium weight cotton or linen.

items.symptom: The traced lines shift from the design
items.fix: Tape both the design and the fabric to the light box surface before beginning.

content.text: Light box transfer is the default method in most surface embroidery workshops because it is fast and accurate.
by light box leaves no residue and is safe for all thin-to-medium fabrics.
